readOnlyNodeModules.why: Vite bundles vitest.config.ts into node_modules/.vite-temp before any test runs, so the subject's own runner fails with EACCES against a read-only node_modules (checked by running node_modules/.bin/vitest by hand). The scratch mode here uses --scratch-dir with the writable node_modules; js-jest-newsletter covers the read-only case.
